description: Keeps the main thread thin: a clearly multi-step / implementation-shaped Bash by the orchestrator (chained >2 steps, a heredoc, sed -i/tee, npm/cargo/make build, git commit/push, pytest/test runs, AND all `gh` incl. `gh ship`/`gh pr`/`gh run`/`gh api`) warns-then-blocks. A bare >/>> redirect is not implementation on its own. Read-only inspection AND sanctioned orchestration are never blocked, even chained: git status/ls/cat/grep/find, tg, review, git worktree list. ALL `gh` is DELEGATED to a subagent now (Alex tg#7103, reverting the #159/#162 gh-ship carve-out): shipping (`gh ship`) and CI/PR verification (`gh pr checks/view`, `gh run`, `gh api`) are a subagent's job, not inline orchestrator work. Subagent commands (agent_id present) are allowed. WARN first, BLOCK on repeat within ORCH_THIN_TTL_S (900s). Per-repo opt-out: agent_hooks.orchestrator_only:false in rig.yaml or RIG_ORCHESTRATOR_ONLY=0 (default ON). Escape hatch: ALLOW_ORCHESTRATOR_WORK=1 + ALLOW_ORCHESTRATOR_WORK_REASON='why', or inline `# orchestrator-ok: why` (pre-bash only). on_error=open.
